prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Preparing your pet desktop environment", "Your pet is getting ready to hop onto your desktop. You will see them appear shortly!"]
1: ["Choose your desktop companion", "Select your favorite pet breed to spawn directly on your desktop display.", "Select Pet Species"]
2: ["How would you like to start?", "Choose between ready-to-adopt pets or customized companion creation."]
3: ["Your pet is live on your desktop!", "Look for your companion roaming your screen. Use your taskbar/menu bar icon to open pet settings anytime."]
4: ["Sign in to keep your desktop pet saved", "Logging in connects your pet to your account so progress and custom pets are never lost on restart.", "Use the email address linked to your existing pet profile."]
5: ["If your pet does not appear immediately, check your system tray or menu bar icon to summon it."]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially registered! Starter food and play items have been added to your inventory.", "Starter Toy Pack Unlocked"]
7: ["Meet your desktop companion", "Your pet is active! Click and drag or right-click your pet on desktop for interaction options.", "Finish Setup"]
8: ["We will notify you as soon as your pet renders on your desktop."]
9: ["Select your pet creation method", "Pick a ready-made animated pet or upload photos to generate a custom 3D companion.", "Continue"]
